messages:
jordan: quick q — for Redwood Private (VPC) control plane + dataplane: what's our stance on KEK/DEK handling and fallback if AWS KMS is unavailable? need to pin down rotation + incident steps :thinking:
anya: we should do envelope encryption: per-tenant DEKs generated by control plane, DEKs encrypted (wrapped) with customer or service KEK in KMS. control plane caches wrapped DEKs and only unwraps when needed. dataplane only stores encrypted DEKs and requests unwrapped token from control plane when computing outputs. keeps plaintext DEKs ephemeral. :lock:
sam: for customer-managed keys (BYOK) we need cross-account grants or a dedicated admin role. key policy should allow our control-plane role to Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt with explicit Condition on SourceVpc and SourceAccount. example snippet (high level):
```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-controlplane"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceVpc":"vpc-0abc1234"}}}]}
```
kevin: additionally enforce encryption-context on all wrap/unwrap ops (tenant id, env). require kms:EncryptionContext:tenant in key policy or via IAM condition to prevent rewrap misuse. log every Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt in CloudTrail and push to central logs for alerting.
infra-bot: perf test: control-plane unwrap latency ~45ms median with KMS in same region; cache reduces calls by ~70% for typical workloads. posting full results to https://redwood.internal/infra/kms-tests — see chart. :bar_chart:
sec-oncall: Incident playbook (short):
1) suspicion of KEK compromise => immediately DisableKey (not delete).
2) revoke active grants and rotate service roles that can call KMS.
3) schedule a bulk rewrap: create new KEK in customer account (or ours if fallback), then ReEncrypt all DEKs with destination-key-id pointing to new KEK.
4) deploy rolling cache invalidation across control-plane and dataplane so nodes fetch newly rewrapped DEKs.
5) run verification prompts/evals to ensure no data corruption.
Note: disabling key prevents Decrypt calls; have a tested fallback KEK (secondary) ready for emergency rewrap.
jordan: question — how do we implement fallback KEK without expanding blast radius? we don't want a static secondary in our account that can decrypt customer data.
anya: options:
- customer-provided secondary KEK (preferred): customer creates a second CMK with cross-account grants.
- HSM-backed key in customer cloud (CloudHSM) with a strict key policy.
- software fallback: if absolutely necessary, store an encrypted rewrap bundle in the customer's KMS-only-accessible S3 and require customer operator action to rewrap.
All options must be opt-in and documented in the onboarding checklist.
sam: RBAC changes: create a dedicated kms-rewrap role with MFA + short-lived sessions, require approval via our access workflow to initiate bulk rewraps. Add CloudTrail triggers that require a ticket number in encryption-context for bulk ops.
kevin: operational bits: use aws kms re-encrypt for bulk rewrap jobs. sample command we tested (replace placeholders):
```bash
aws kms reencrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://enc-dek.bin --source-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/old-kek --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/new-kek --encryption-context '{"tenant":"acme-corp"}' --output text > dek-rewrapped.bin
```
Make sure to preserve and validate encryption-context on every re-encrypt.
sec-oncall: vuln/triage notes: if a compromised IAM role is detected, treat as KEK-compromise candidate until proven otherwise. follow revoke->rotate->rewrap->verify. maintain runbook with timings and a small-scale drill at least quarterly.
jordan: ok actionable items?
anya: 1) draft key-policy template with aws:SourceVpc and encryption-context conditions — PR by EOD Thu. 2) infra to add CloudTrail alerts for kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/ReEncrypt with high-rate thresholds. 3) sec to build emergency rewrap playbook + test plan.
sam: I'll own RBAC changes + the short-lived rewrap role.
kevin: I'll add cache invalidation hooks and a rolling rewrap job skeleton to infra repo.
sec-oncall: I'll schedule a tabletop for the compromise scenario next week and draft the runbook.
jordan: thanks everyone — link this thread in the private-deploy onboarding doc and ping product for opt-in checkbox on fallback KEK. :thumbsup:
